Complete at least 1,000 USDT in qualifying spot trading volume.
Don’t miss your chance to earn rewards. Join now!

CandyDrop is Gate’s candy airdrop platform where users complete tasks to earn candies and share token airdrops. We are excited to launch the VLX token airdrop event, where you can complete the following tasks to earn candies and share a total prize pool of 227,273 VLX, with a maximum individual share of 800 VLX.

Users spot trade on Gate, with VLX, achieving a spot trading volume (buy + sell) ≥ 1,000 USDT, will earn 1 candy. The total reward pool is 170,000 VLX. Maximum per user: 600 VLX. The reward rule is as follows:
Volume of spot trade ≥ 1,000 USDT: 1 Candy
Volume of spot trade ≥ 3,000 USDT: 3 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 5,000 USDT: 5 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 7,000 USDT: 10 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 10,000 USDT: 15 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 20,000 USDT: 30 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 30,000 USDT: 50 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 50,000 USDT: 80 Candies

Market makers, enterprises, and institutions are not allowed to participate in this event. Agent accounts cannot participate in friend-invitation type activities, while other activities are unrestricted.
In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
Gate has the final interpretation rights for this event.

Users in restricted areas cannot access all or part of the services (including participating in this event, game, or competition). For more information about restricted areas, please read User Agreement.
